scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:api: cross-env DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=../../.env PORT=8080 npm run dev -w @workspace/api-server
scripts.dev:web: cross-env PORT=5173 BASE_PATH=/ npm run dev -w @workspace/enrollment-system
scripts.build:local: npm run build -w @workspace/enrollment-system && npm run build -w @workspace/api-server
